user.description: Select a discovered Claber device. Supported: Hydro-4 BT (90840) and Rain Sensor BT (90844). Status comes from BLE adverts. Hydro-4 also exposes valves, duration, Stop and programs; GATT only on explicit command.

bluetooth_confirm_rain.description:
Do you want to set up {name}?

State is read from BLE adverts, with no connection.

bluetooth_confirm_hydro.description:
Do you want to set up {name}?

Status comes from BLE adverts. You also get line valves 1–4, manual duration, Stop, and program A/B entities. GATT is used only when you press an explicit command (never in the background).

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a supported Claber model (or its manufacturer data could not be resolved safely).
abort.model_not_supported_yet: This Claber model code is recognized but not supported yet.
abort.no_devices_found: No supported Claber devices found. Make sure your device is powered on and within range of a Bluetooth adapter or Bluetooth proxy.

init.title: Claber BT options
init.description: Hydro commands ({scope}) use MAC-derived auth only, with no PIN. An optional preferred Bluetooth source pins the connect path. This integration creates no automations and does not expose entities to HomeKit or Assist.

data.preferred_bluetooth_source: Preferred Bluetooth source id (optional; leave empty to use the last connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy source)

abort.options_only_hydro: Command options are only available for Hydro-4 BT entries.
